subject: AWS marketplace onboarding & co-marketing credit — proposed sprint plan
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: AWS marketplace onboarding & co-marketing credit — proposed sprint plan

Hi Sandeep,

Thanks again for carving out time to talk about Marketplace listing support. Following our call, attaching a short SOW outlining a 6-week onboarding sprint plus proposed co-marketing credit structure. High level ask:

- USD 75k co-marketing credit (to fund joint webinars, PR, and paid placements)
- USD 25k onboarding services credit (AWS Marketplace integration + metering QA)
- 12-month reduced listing commission for first-year bookings (we're proposing a 10% temporary reduction to help early conversions)

Key deliverables in the SOW:
- Marketplace metering verification & billing QA
- Listing technical review and sample deployments for two reference customers
- Joint webinar + 1 co-branded case study
- Measurement plan and MQL handoff definition

Attachment: proposed_onboarding_SOW.pdf (short SOW + timeline)

Could you confirm:
1) whether AWS can approve the two credits above as partner credits (not a direct discount)
2) any internal Marketplace thresholds or commit language we should expect for the reduced fee pilot
3) suggested next steps (we'd like to get legal/procurement aligned this week)

I'm looping Vanessa for marketing coordination and Jordan for procurement cadence. Happy to jump on a quick call with your marketplace specialist if that's easier.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

---
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@amazon.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Kim <emily.kim@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS marketplace onboarding & co-marketing credit — proposed sprint plan

Hi Hannah — thanks for the note and the clear SOW. Appreciate the detail. A few quick items from our side:

- We can typically structure two credit buckets like you outlined (co-marketing vs onboarding services). The teams require a short commitment letter and capture of the expected measurable outcomes (clicks/registrations/bookings).
- For discounted listing fees: AWS Marketplace team will consider short pilots but we need: (a) estimated ARR through Marketplace for year 1 and (b) an internal Marketplace sponsor who will agree to an exception for a pilot.
- I'll need to loop in our Marketplace onboarding specialist (Emily Kim) and our Partner Sales Finance manager to sign off on the dollar amounts.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Share expected 12-month Marketplace booking projection (high/likely/low) — this helps underwrite the fee pilot.
2) Sign a short Letter of Intent / commitment (we can do a template) — attach to HubSpot deal.
3) Introduce the finance/legal owners — I can do introductions once you send the projection + redline SOW.

I'll provisionally hold the co-marketing credit request subject to approvals. Happy to join a 30m sync this week — Emily, can you confirm availability?

Best,
Sandeep Rao
Sr. Partner Manager, Marketplace Ecosystem
Amazon Web Services

---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: AWS marketplace onboarding & co-marketing credit — proposed sprint plan

Team — forwarding AWS response and next steps. Action items:

- Jordan: can you draft a short projection (high/likely/low) for Marketplace bookings tied to the pilot by EOD Tuesday? We need numbers to give AWS Finance.
- Vanessa: confirm if marketing can commit to two webinars + one case study and provide a rough budget allocation if we take the AWS co-marketing credit (they typically require spend plan).
- Laura: legal — please have a quick look at the attached SOW and flag any standard redlines (esp. indemnity/measurement clauses).

Attachment: proposed_onboarding_SOW.pdf (same as above)

Thanks — if we get those three items ready, Sandeep said he'll introduce the AWS finance/legal owners and Emily (Marketplace onboarding).

—Hannah

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: AWS marketplace onboarding & co-marketing credit — proposed sprint plan

Quick procurement notes after a rapid review:

- We can support structuring credits two ways: (1) AWS issues co-marketing credit that flows through to our marketing spend, or (2) we accept onboarding services credit as a reduction to our invoice for third-party integrator work (CloudBridge). For accounting clarity, 1 is easier.
- Procurement redline suggestions (attached): clearly split deliverables tied to each credit; add a 30-day measurement window after webinar for conversion tracking; include an escape clause if Marketplace integration adds >15% dev lift vs estimate.
- We should avoid any language that locks us into a revenue commit beyond a pilot threshold. If AWS requires commits, request a small nominal threshold (e.g., $100k expected first-year Marketplace bookings) rather than an aggressive ARR target.

Attachment: procurement_terms_redline.docx (highlights + suggested language)

I'll put together the projection template and circulate by EOD tomorrow.

—Jordan
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

---
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@amazon.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Emily Kim <emily.kim@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, CloudBridge Partners <procurement@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS marketplace onboarding & co-marketing credit — proposed sprint plan

Hannah — thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on the SOW and Jordan's procurement notes, I can provisionally confirm the following pending our finance sign-off and a short commitment letter:

- Co-marketing credit: USD 60k (provisional) for joint demand gen, to be applied as AWS partner marketing funds.
- Onboarding services credit: USD 25k (approved) to offset third-party integrator charges for metering and QA.
- Marketplace fee pilot: AWS Marketplace team will evaluate a temporary fee reduction; we'll need your 12-month booking projection.

I'm attaching a short commitment letter template and a provisional internal approval note: aws_onboarding_commitment_letter.pdf

Next steps:
- Hannah/Jordan: share the projection + sign the commitment letter draft.
- Emily (cc): can we schedule a 30-min kickoff this Friday to align onboarding tasks?

If you can get the signed LOI and projections in the HubSpot deal link, I'll escalate to finance for final sign-off.

Best regards,
Sandeep Rao
Sr. Partner Manager, Marketplace Ecosystem
Amazon Web Services
